heading: Transfer date
lead: In this part, the term “transfer date” means the date on which the National Intelligence University is transferred from the Defense Intelligence Agency to the Director of National Intelligence under section 3334a(a) of this title.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The transfer date, referred to in text, is June 20, 2021.

sourceCredit: (July 26, 1947, ch. 343, title X, § 1031, as added Pub. L. 116–260, div. W, title III, § 305(a), Dec. 27, 2020, 134 Stat. 2366.)
